description: List line moves in one league over the last few minutes to hours: markets whose main line (handicap, totals, player and team over/unders) moved at one or more bookmakers, with steam (several bookmakers moving the same way) and whether Pinnacle moved with them. Head to head markets have no line and are not covered. Keeps moves where an Australian bookmaker moved unless region is all. Needs Pro or the free Pro trial; 10 credits a call.

league_id.description: League key, for example nba, nfl, afl or nrl. Required.

min_books.description: Fewest bookmakers moving the same way to count as steam. Default 3.

region.description: Keep moves where a bookmaker in this region moved. Default au. Use all for every bookmaker.

window_minutes.description: Minutes to look back, in steps of 5. Default 60.

name: line_moves
title: Line moves and steam
